specs.rationale: Desktop accessibility oracles exercise control names, state and keyboard reachability; representative deterministic world data through the real runtime is sufficient.
Mobile accessibility oracles exercise touch reachability, drawers and focus restoration; complete real-world bytes do not affect those assertions.
The current semantic API diagnostics and published-record search assertions exercise real published record compatibility, but no complete-world census or scale property.
Desktop audit controls, coordinate navigation, zoom, pan and LOD transitions can be proven with a deterministic multi-floor qualification region.
Mobile drawer and representation-transition audits depend on runtime behavior and viewport state, not complete FullWorld content.
Most interaction cases are fixture-sufficient, but the current fixed monster overlap/card assertion depends on a bounded real published placement; complete-world coverage is unnecessary.
Mobile creature activation and inspector behavior need representative NPC and monster placements, not complete-world identity or scale.
Current presentation oracles assert factual mixed-scene roles, dense names, LOD and lifecycle behavior against bounded real placements, without a whole-product claim.
Current mobile presentation assertions use factual bounded real badges and detail/minimap labels; their oracle does not require complete FullWorld bytes.
Controls and repaint are fixture-sufficient, while the current Sam search/deep-link case asserts bounded real publication integration; no complete corpus is required.
Search outage, malformed schema and degraded-state oracles rely on controlled positive and negative publication variants, which belong in the qualification fixture.
The current desktop smoke asserts Thais navigation and a representative verified range against real published data, but not complete-world census correctness.
The current Farm Explorer desktop flow is tied to the bounded real Cave Rat identity and URL facts; complete FullWorld content is not part of the oracle.
The current mobile Farm Explorer flow is tied to the bounded real Cave Rat facts, while making no complete-world identity, census or scale claim.
Desktop base and creature geometry synchronization, floor isolation and deep-link restoration require representative multi-floor topology, not complete-world coverage.
Mobile resize geometry preservation is a transform and synchronization oracle that a bounded deterministic multi-floor fixture can prove.
Layer availability and fail-closed state assertions need representative layer inputs and negative variants rather than complete FullWorld content.
The current mobile smoke asserts Sam semantic navigation against bounded real published data; complete-world identity or scale is not asserted.
The current normalized high-density workload records structural budgets over bounded real data; it does not measure complete FullWorld volume or scale.
Race and cancellation scenarios require controlled delayed range responses and representative geometry, which a deterministic fixture can reproduce exactly.
WebGL non-blank and committed-frame replacement probes test renderer behavior over representative detail pixels, not complete-world publication completeness.
Corrupt ranges, malformed products, missing optional data and version mismatches are deterministic loader/runtime failure oracles suited to fixture variants.
Responsive controls, backdrop behavior, resizing and optional creature controls are viewport and shell oracles independent of complete-world bytes.
The current scale oracle searches a bounded published corpus of more than fifty records with a sampled cap, rather than asserting production FullWorld scale.
The current soak uses a bounded repeated structural-growth workload over real representative data; complete FullWorld volume is not part of its oracle.
Coordinate state, reload, history and invalid-input behavior need stable representative bounds and navigation state, not a complete real publication.
The seeded interaction stress oracle checks renderer and creature geometry invariants over replayable actions, not complete-world scale or census.
Desktop user journeys require representative cross-feature search, map, creature and state data while making no complete-world correctness claim.
Mobile user journeys require representative touch-first cross-feature data and production runtime seams, not complete-world identity or scale.

After isolating the exhaustive animation coverage census, the remaining desktop visual spec contains a bounded real Thais journey plus fixture-sufficient transition and playback oracles; no complete-world claim remains.
The isolated full authoritative animation coverage census verifies the complete published programs product, exact manifest digest and production-wide coverage counts.
The current mobile chrome/drawer visual case uses a bounded real Thais result while its local pixel-toggle case is fixture-sufficient; no complete-world oracle exists.
Published semantic-result navigation, reload and history restoration dynamically selects an adequate record and does not depend on complete real-world coverage.
